items.question: Within how many days after the campaign ends will winners be notified?
items.gold: Within 28 days after the campaign ends.
items.fact: Winners are notified within 28 days after campaign ends.

items.question: Can a customer apply a promo code after completing checkout?
items.gold: No, codes cannot be applied retrospectively.
items.fact: Promo codes cannot be applied retrospectively after checkout is completed.
